CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JUNE 9, 2026

A regular meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 5 :33 p.m., on
Tuesday, June 9, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tern Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Assistant City Clerk Maria Dacanay-Wisner

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5 :33 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tern Zwick. Councilmember
  Zernitskaya led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

ACCOUNT ABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Negrete.

ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

  Report and Item 2 (Special Agenda Items), prior to [tern 1 (general Public
